description: Defines a template class for a lock-free bounded multi-producer multi-consumer queue using MoodyCamel's concurrent queue library, including specializations for non-blocking and sleeping wait policies, with associated consumer classes and queue management methods.

classes.name: ocudu::concurrent_queue<T, concurrent_queue_policy::moodycamel_lockfree_bounded_mpmc, concurrent_queue_wait_policy::non_blocking>
classes.description: Main template class implementing a lock-free bounded MPMC queue with non-blocking behavior.

classes.name: ocudu::concurrent_queue<T, concurrent_queue_policy::moodycamel_lockfree_bounded_mpmc, concurrent_queue_wait_policy::sleep>
classes.description: Specialization of the concurrent queue with sleep-based blocking mechanism.

classes.name: ocudu::concurrent_queue<T, policy, wait_policy>::consumer_type
classes.description: Consumer class for dequeuing elements from the queue efficiently.

methods.name: calculate_capacity
methods.description: Calculates the actual capacity reserved by the MoodyCamel queue based on requested size and number of producers.

methods.name: try_push
methods.description: Attempts to enqueue an element into the queue without blocking.

methods.name: try_push_bulk
methods.description: Attempts to enqueue a bulk of elements into the queue.

methods.name: push_blocking
methods.description: Enqueues an element into the queue, blocking if necessary.

methods.name: try_pop
methods.description: Attempts to dequeue an element without blocking.

methods.name: try_pop_bulk
methods.description: Attempts to dequeue multiple elements without blocking.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns an approximate size of the queue.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the queue is empty.

methods.name: capacity
methods.description: Returns the capacity of the queue.

methods.name: create_consumer
methods.description: Creates a consumer object for dequeuing elements.
